title: Mr. Ishibashi (the guard): a 3D model made the way Kuro, Aoi and Emi were
question: The first two sheets are ChatGPT pictures; every sheet after them is a render of the real rigged model, which you can turn in the live viewer next to Eric, Mio, Kuro, Aoi and Emi (link below). He is in the game now. Is the guard right?

options.label: guard-1
options.note: The rigged model from d1 (chat a1, b1, c1, d1): smart topology, 1,050 polygons, our UV layout with the face and eyes in one piece, Meshy retexture styled from d1, auto-rig at 1.1 m, Meshy sit. Head share 0.46. In the game at 1.09 tall in place of his code-built body, hand bones at 0.75. 23 Meshy credits; five pictures $1.24.
